{
  "finding_id": "FINDING-CASE-5521-B",
  "verdict": "HELD",
  "identified_issues": [
    "Identifiability rank deficiency: Active observation surfaces (PT-401 and ACC-102) fail to separate benign thermal duct contraction from hazardous dynamic face seal fracture.",
    "State-observation conflation: Flight safety controller imputed mechanical seal failure directly from pressure drop telemetry without resolving the instrument nullspace.",
    "Critical discriminator outage: The orthogonal witness channel (HE-SNIFF-01) was offline during the transient event, leaving the underlying physical state unidentifiable.",
    "Epistemic inflation: Declaring definitive turbopump failure without distinguishing evidence violates mandatory epistemic abstention rules."
  ],
  "evidence": [
    "Pressure transducer PT-401 recorded delta P = -1.15 bar over 140 ms, which falls simultaneously within the signature envelope for thermal duct contraction (-1.0 to -1.3 bar) and dynamic face seal fracture (-1.0 to -1.3 bar).",
    "Accelerometer ACC-102 recorded a transient peak at 44.2 Hz, falling within both the duct contraction resonance band (40-48 Hz) and the shaft resonance band (40-48 Hz).",
    "Helium tracer sniffer HE-SNIFF-01 log at 2026-10-06T14:22:00.000Z confirms 'Sensor status: OFFLINE_CALIBRATION_PURGE. Port isolated for scheduled zero-point drift recalibration.'",
    "HE-SNIFF-01 log at 2026-10-06T14:22:10.600Z confirms 'Secondary purge helium concentration: N/A (no sample stream acquired during transient interval). Integrity: UNKNOWN.'"
  ],
  "recommended_action": "Enforce mandatory epistemic abstention and hold the countdown evaluation as HELD. Invalidate any definitive PASS or FAIL determination pending re-acquisition of orthogonal discriminant data. Bring HE-SNIFF-01 online, verify zero-point calibration, restore sample stream intake, and execute a post-transient helium sniff test on the secondary inter-seal drain line before lifting the hold.",
  "confidence": "HIGH"
}
